title: Local queue workflow, 256-slot concurrency, and fault-injection measurements
setup: 4 local Worker/SQLite cells (q01..q16 queues): separate 16-pipeline workflow test, 5-tier concurrency test up to 256 slots, and controlled fault-injection suite
notes: Separates the 16-pipeline local workflow run (54.441 ms median across 25,620 MCP calls) from the 5-tier concurrency run (512 Tasks in the 256-slot tier, 992 Tasks across all 5 tiers, 0 duplicate lease tuples).

Controlled local recovery checks verified 16 of 16 expired-lease reassignments (fencing token 2) with HTTP 409 on stale heartbeats and submissions, plus 16 direct self-approval and 16 capability HTTP 403 refusals.
All test workflows used generated test payloads with zero private information.
